name: Kalibrr
long_description:
Kalibrr operates a two-sided job marketplace in Southeast Asia with over 5,000,000 high-skill white collar talents primarily in the Philippines and Indonesia. 

With Kalibrr, you can recruit and build a remote sales, product, engineering or design team in the Philippines within minutes
one_liner: Kalibrr connects SEAsian talent to your local & global jobs.

founders.title: Founder
founders.founder_bio: Danny has been designing and building products since the 1990s. In early 2000s, he wrote his first machine learning algorithms to play board games, to control articulated arms, and to trade on the financial markets. As a consultant, he has advised leaders across multiple industries (mining, energy, hospitality, retail, finance, and transportation). Danny is Y-Combinator founder with a Masters in Comp. Eng. from McGill (machine learning) and an MBA from MIT. He has 3 kids and practices+coaches Ji

founders.title: Founder/COO
founders.founder_bio: Led product at Kalibrr (YC W13) building our design, product management, and engineering teams from the ground up.  Kalibrr became the leading tech hiring platform in the Philippines and Indonesia.
